item.title: Nicholas Hoult Teases "Awesome" MAN OF TOMORROW; SUPERMAN Soars To Top Of IMDB's Most Popular List
item.description: Nicholas Hoult has revealed when he starts shooting Man of Tomorrow and praises James Gunn's script for the movie. Superman, meanwhile, has been named IMDb's most popular movie of 2025 based on views...

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Will Focus On Doctor Doom vs. [SPOILER], Not Mister Fantastic
item.description: The latest Avengers: Doomsday rumour reveals the main foe for Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom in the movie, and it seemingly won't be Pedro Pascal's Mister Fantastic. You can learn more after the jump...

item.title: SUPERMAN's Sara Sampaio On Potentially Returning As Eve Teschmacher In MAN OF TOMORROW
item.description: Sara Sampaio certainly made an impression as Lex Luthor's seemingly ditzy girlfriend in James Gunn's Superman, and the actress/model has now addressed her potential return for Man of Tomorrow...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Letitia Wright Shares Comic Research That May Be A Potential Spoiler For The Movie
item.description: After recently confirming that she'll return as Shuri in Avengers: Secret Wars, Letitia Wright has shared some comic book research that may provide a big hint about what's to come in Avengers: Doomsday.

item.title: “[Don’t] Use Me Or My Work To Take Sides”: Miles Morales Co-Creator Clarifies Comments About Media Royalties
item.description: Miles Morales co-creator Sara Pichelli has released a statement on Instagram, clarifying comments she made during a convention interview regarding royalties for the character.

item.title: SCREAM 7: Sam Carpenter Was Originally Going To Become Ghostface Before Melissa Barrera's Firing
item.description: Confirming a popular fan-theory, Skeet Ulrich has revealed that the original plan was for Sam Carpenter to give in to her murderous instincts and suit-up as Ghostface in Scream 7...

item.title: SUPERMAN And THE BATMAN Statues At Convention Spark Speculation About Robert Pattinson Joining The DCU
item.description: Statues of David Corenswet’ Superman and Robert Pattinson’s Batman were placed next to each other at CCXP in Brazil, leading fans to voice their desire to see Matt Reeves’ Bruce Wayne in the DCU.

item.title: Why SUPERGIRL Dropped Its “WOMAN OF TOMORROW” Subtitle May Have Been Right Under Our Noses All Along
item.description: Supergirl was originally called Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow. Turns out, one of the main reasons for DC Studios dropping the subtitle might have been staring right at us all along.
